findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "audit" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: show_audit · Private data: start_audit, measure_in_app, prepare_script · Public sink: start_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: show_audit · Private data: start_audit, measure_in_app, prepare_script · Public sink: start_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
